blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Beyond the familiar mayas and herons, the province of Albay is home to a diverse array of birds, including species found only in the Philippines and migratory birds that visit the country. This diversity is captured in a collection of wildlife photographs by Dr. Gianina M. Andes of Daraga, Albay, who has been documenting birds in different parts of the province since 2025. Featured by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Bicol Region through its “EKwento” series, the photographs offer a closer look at the avian wildlife that often goes unnoticed in everyday surroundings.
